sources.title: Toxic Comment Classification using BERT - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: It allows the model to assign zero, one, or more labels to each data sample based on its characteristics. In the context of toxic comment classification, a comment or text can be labelled with multiple toxicity categories if it contains various forms of harmful language.
